slug: 2026-03-24 Zambia looking for MOSIP system integrator to support digital ID project

systems.tiers: national; planned, with full rollout targeted for the end of 2026; a system integrator is being sought

note: The only system described is the planned national digital ID, of class identity. The civil registration architecture is named only as what the MOSIP-based ID is to be integrated with (March 2026, a planned link, not built); nothing is said of what it does or where. Finance for the ID is the World Bank's IDA through DZAP, over USD 100 million.
